sources.title: Primary cyclotomic units and a proof of Catalans conjecture
sources.enterprise_use: After P025 low derivative-capacity rigidity reduces persistent low-capacity unit relations to bounded-exponent prime powers outside a finite core, Mihailescu's theorem supplies the external classification of consecutive proper perfect powers.
sources.not_claimed: Catalan's conjecture/Mihailescu's theorem and its cyclotomic proof are external prior mathematics and are not Enterprise Math inventions.
